recipe.title: Tandoori chicken salad
recipe.notes: This is from Nadia Lim's cookbook, Easy Weeknight Meals.

method.s: Halve any larger potatoes so they are all roughly the same size. Toss with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Roast for 40-45 minutes until golden and crispy.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Rub tandoori paste all over and place in an ovenproof dish. Drizzle with a little olive oil, juice of 0.5 lemon, and season with salt.
In the last 15 minutes of the potatoes' cooking time, add chicken to oven above the potatoes for 15 minutes or until cooked through (when juices run clear).
Prepare the rest of the salad ingredients.
Combine all yoghurt dressing ingredients and set aside. Mix in any juices from the cooked chicken.
When ready to serve, slice chicken thighs into 4-5 pieces. Toss with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, bagel crisps or croutons, baby spinach, cashew nuts and coriander.
Drizzle over yoghurt dressing and serve with potatoes on the side.
